decisions.quote: We were able to replicate the use of several PLR metrics as a biomarker for mTBI diagnosis that could easily be included with standard clinical measures.
decisions.reason: NEW deposited current references explicitly cite shipped Dengler3032 with2025issue year matching2024electronic publication, so lack of a reference list is no longer the reason to withhold. However references also include other PLR empirical reports and a complete Focus companion report, while the current abstract does not connect its generic replication statement to a particular earlier finding. Parent inspected current196cadet assessment stages/PLR endpoints and original1300baseline/68incidentcases and21dayprediction, plus Focus full-report evidence of deeper analysis of prior pending/unpublished work with68cases in2021–2022. Those passages support an actual possible companion-analysis relation, not an automatic second independent original from a different DOI. Unequal196/68sample counts alone cannot determine new recruitment, expansion, overlap or eligibility changes. Current and shipped full bodies remain inaccessible after documented fresh publisher/browser/repository/OA/Wayback attempts; actual attribution and cohort relation therefore remain unknown. Retain this target on the separate unresolved list; do not list a new absent paper, declare no target, or bind shipped identity solely from authors/topic. Complete Focus body is a DIFFERENT report and is not promoted as current4151. The exposed reviewer supplied source evidence only and did not blind code.
